data.title: Interest on 2023 income tax refund (Erstattungszinsen)
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispielsoest notifies Bastian Musterquell that it will pay interest (Erstattungszinsen) of €42.00 for 28 full months on the refund from the revised 2023 income tax assessment, to be transferred together with the refund.
data.explanation: This letter from the tax office (Finanzamt) confirms you will receive €42.00 in interest on your 2023 income tax refund, covering 28 full months, paid together with the refund automatically. This interest counts as investment income (Einkünfte aus Kapitalvermögen) for tax purposes, and you'll get a separate certificate for it. If you think the amount or the number of months is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt Beispielsoest; the app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, this notice becomes final and the interest is simply paid as stated — no other action is required.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Einspruch) to the interest assessment
items.action: If you disagree with the interest amount or the number of months credited, file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt Beispielsoest in writing
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the interest assessment becomes final
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben.

remedy.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben. Die Frist beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei Versand durch die Post am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post eintritt.

data.tax_note: Erstattungszinsen are taxable investment income (Einkünfte aus Kapitalvermögen); report them in your tax return once you receive the separate certificate mentioned in the letter.
